requirement: The system shall securely store customer data.
The system shall encrypt customer data using AES-256 at rest.
The system shall generate reports regularly.
The system shall generate reports every Monday at 09:00.
The system shall maintain high availability.
The system shall maintain 99.9% monthly availability.
The application shall appropriately handle errors.
The application shall log errors to the syslog daemon and return HTTP 500.
The module shall be very efficient.
The module shall utilize no more than 512 MB of RAM.
The system shall provide adequate capacity of 100 GB.
The system shall provide exactly 100 GB of storage capacity per user block.
The UI shall be easy to use.
The UI shall pass WCAG 2.1 AA compliance testing.
The backend will safely parse inputs.
The backend will validate inputs against the JSON schema defined in spec v1.2.
